_note: Backlog of official Q&A rulings on DSL-implemented cards (code/digimon-engine/cards/*/*.yaml). Full ruling text: data/card_official_qa.json / data/card_bundles/<ID>.md. assertion_templates[answer_polarity] is a mechanical starting point by answer polarity, not a curated assertion — see qa/aegis-kb/test-seeds.md for curated ones. Sorted: tested_cards first, non-generic first, then deck usage. Source of each ruling: https://world.digimoncard.com/rule/?card_no=<card>. `about` is the card the ruling is about; cross_listed=true means it is listed on this card's page because this card is named in a ruling on `about`.

assertion_templates.yes: assert the asked-about action/trigger IS offered or happens (mask/pending_selection/state), plus a control without the enabling condition
assertion_templates.value: assert the specific outcome the answer states (count/DP/zone/order) — read the full ruling in the bundle
assertion_templates.no: assert the asked-about action/trigger is NOT offered or does not happen, plus a control proving the path is live when the ruling's condition is absent
